cases.refreshed: Need help with 3D printing or want hands-on practice? This guided session helps beginners build confidence using a 3D printer. It's also a chance to practice if you've taken the library's 3D Design & Printing workshop. You can print a simple model under supervision. If you do not have a design, you may choose a free design from Thingiverse or a similar site. All designs are printed in one PLA filament color chosen by the program lead. Designs must print in 1 hour and 45 minutes. If you're unsure how long your design will take to print, email cz.sjpl@sjlibrary.org. All designs must be compatible with the Creality K1C printer. The program lead decides whether a design can be printed. SJPL reserves the right to refuse any print request. Each person is limited to one appointment per month.

cases.refreshed: Children of all ages and their families can build early literacy skills through stories, songs, rhymes, fingerplays, and movement. After storytime, families are invited to Stay & Play. The storytime librarian will be on the Children's Room floor with special toys until 6:30 pm. Meet new friends, play with toys, chat, get book recommendations, and maybe even create something! Storytime: 5:30-6:00 PM; Stay & Play: 6:00-6:30 PM. Free, with limited capacity. This program is developed to align with the Early Education Quality Standards.

cases.refreshed: Infant and Toddler Storytime invites children and their caregivers to wiggle, rhyme, and sing with diverse books, songs, and fingerplays that encourage language, play, and exploration. The program is designed for children ages 0 to 3 and their parents or caregivers. Children of all ages are welcome. After Storytime concludes, we invite you to Stay & Play! The storytime librarian will be on the Children's Room floor with special toys until 12 PM. Meet new friends, play with toys, chat, get book recommendations, and maybe even create something! Storytime runs from 11:00 to 11:30 AM. Stay & Play runs from 11:30 AM to 12:00 PM. This program is developed to align with the Early Education Quality Standards.

cases.refreshed: This program is best for children ages 0–8 and their caregivers. All families are welcome. Storytime is designed to accommodate a mix of ages and invites the entire family to participate in early literacy activities such as stories, songs, rhymes, fingerplays, and movement activities. Storytime is a fun and interactive experience for the whole family that promotes the joys of reading and learning for all ages. After storytime, families are invited to Stay & Play. The storytime librarian will be on the Children's Room floor with special toys until 5 PM. Meet new friends, play with toys, chat, get book recommendations, and maybe even create something! Storytime runs from 4:00 to 4:30 PM. Stay & Play runs from 4:30 to 5:00 PM. Please note that this will be an indoor program. Free, with limited capacity. This program is developed to align with the Early Education Quality Standards.

cases.refreshed: Children can practice reading aloud to gentle, trained assistance dogs. You can use this program to reduce fines and fees for lost or damaged items. The library deducts $5 from juvenile accounts for every 15 minutes you are read to. Please check in at the 2nd Floor Info Desk for additional information. For youth ages 0-10. Free. No registration required.

cases.refreshed: Practice speaking English in an informal and supportive group; make new friends too! No registration is required, and you do not need to attend every week. Basic English knowledge recommended. For accessibility accommodations (e.g., ASL), please fill out the online form at sccld.org/accessibility 7+ days prior to the event. If you need assistance with the form, speak with a staff member at your local library, call (408) 540-3947, or email us at ask@lib.sccgov.org.
